authorityRules: The Quest shell never owns canonical mission state.
Offline mode is read-only and cannot cache approval authority.
A reconnect never repeats or infers approval.
The control plane remains separate from optional media streaming.
Identity, target revision, freshness, risk and expiry must be verified before any future approval path is enabled.
currentLimitations: The Holodeck Baseline immersive WebXR source path is implemented, but has not been observed on Quest 3 hardware.
The PWA has not been packaged, signed, uploaded or installed on Quest.
Digital Asset Link values cannot be finalized until a signing key fingerprint exists.
No live Stephanos control-plane endpoint is connected; the bundled bridge projection remains static/mock data.
